blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GCash operator Mynt Inc. has fixed its initial public offering (IPO) price at P6.60 per share, valuing the transaction at as much as P60.93 billion if its overallotment option were fully exercised. On Friday, the Philippine Stocks Exchange (PSE) disclosed that Mynt will offer 8.03 billion common shares — about P53 billion at […]...
